test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Each of the two merchants sell an article for ₹1,000. If Merchant A computes his profit on the cost price, while Merchant B computes his profit on the selling price, then they both end up making profits of 25%. By how much is the profit made by Merchant B more than that of Merchant A?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (S.P.) for both merchants = ₹1,000

Profit Percentage = 25%

**Calculations:**

Merchant A (Profit on Cost Price):

S.P. = C.P. + Profit

⇒ S.P. = C.P. + 25% of C.P.

⇒ (1 + 0.25) &
